{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABbJzrYQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhEvEmI", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 69, "title": "Simplify public camera controls and make IK a true model-wide On/Off toggle", "body": "## User request

The public Uka / Gene Light side-by-side **MMD vs glTF** comparison currently exposes:
- A **View** menu with Front / Side / Back, even though the user can already orbit, pan and zoom the shared camera by dragging.
- A checkbox labeled **Sleeve IK** that enables only Uka's sleeve-specific IK chains.

**Requested behavior:**
1. Remove the redundant **View** selector from the *public comparison* UI. Keep the shared freely orbitable camera and a useful initial framing.
2. Replace **Sleeve IK** with a simple **IK** On/Off control whose meaning is genuinely **all applicable IK controllers of the selected model**, not a sleeve-only shortcut. Apply the same choice to **both** PMX and glTF comparison panes. Keep physics off.

Do **not** just rename the existing checkbox: the implemented algorithm must match the new label.

**Workflow:** This issue is for the designated implementation agent. The issue author is not authorized to implement code, create a branch, or open a PR.

## Current repo evidence (main at `a8c5bfc901c569c71aba7ce7007e3e02d18b9e17`)

- [`examples/index.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/index.html) lines 15–23: public `#viewpoint` Front/Side/Back and `#comparison-sleeves` checkbox with literal label `Sleeve IK`. A **separate hidden synthetic-rig test UI** also has `#rig-viewpoint` and a separate IK/append panel; those are not the public controls and should not be accidentally broken.
- [`examples/main.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts) uses `OrbitControls` plus the `#viewpoint` preset/handler; `sleeves.checked` controls the optional isolated IK pass, with `execution.ik`, `execution.sleeveIK` and status text currently referring to `Sleeve IK only`. Existing model/motion selection already keeps one scene/renderer per character after PR #68.
- [`examples/demo.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/demo.ts) resets `viewpoint` on initial/model changes; update this with any public UI removal.
- [`examples/sleeve-ik.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/sleeve-ik.ts) explicitly hard-codes six names, constructs only six CCD IK chains and writes only those links. It is *not* general IK.
- Pinned Uka source [`docs/uka-inventory.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-inventory.json) records **10 IK controllers**:
  - foot/toe: `左足ＩＫ` (index 8), `左つま先ＩＫ` (9), `右足ＩＫ` (15), `右つま先ＩＫ` (16);
  - sleeve: `左腕袖IK` (61), `左手袖IK` (62), `左手首袖IK` (63), `右腕袖IK` (95), `右手袖IK` (96), `右手首袖IK` (97).
- [`docs/uka-sleeves.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-sleeves.md) contains measured real-Uka before/after sleeve evidence. Preserve it, but **do not confuse a successful six-sleeve result with full 10-controller execution**. Existing Uka `fixedAxes: 4` affects the broader dependency audit. [`packages/mmd-solver/index.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/mmd-solver/index.ts) currently diagnoses some solver-v3 fixed-axis execution as unsupported. Full-model execution needs correct treatment, not silent downselection.
- [`docs/public-motion.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/public-motion.md) describes the currently intentional sleeve-only semantics, provenance and limitations. They must be updated when the public toggle's meaning changes.

## Implementation tasks

### 1. Remove public View selector, preserve camera behavior

- [ ] Delete the **public** `<label>View <select id="viewpoint">…</select></label>` from `examples/index.html`; remove unused public `#viewpoint` lookups, reset logic and change listeners in `examples/main.ts` and `examples/demo.ts`. Do not leave missing-node runtime errors or inactive controls.
- [ ] Keep a sensible initial front/framed camera, existing shared `OrbitControls` (drag orbit, pan, scroll zoom), two-pane synchronized camera, responsive viewport, material/outline/expression controls, canvas lifecycle and model/motion switching. Preserve the user's manually adjusted camera during motion switching, as already done by PR #68.
- [ ] The internal opt-in `?demo=rig` fixture's `#rig-viewpoint`, `#rig-fit` and IK/append diagnostics may remain for conformance work; do not remove or break them as collateral.
- [ ] Update browser tests that currently call `#viewpoint`, including `tests/browser/uka.spec.ts` and `tests/browser/sleeve-motion.spec.ts`. If front/side screenshots are needed for evidence, set the camera programmatically via a test-only, read-only diagnostic interface or manipulate real orbit controls instead of reintroducing a public View menu. Check 390px/mobile layout with one less control.

### 2. Make IK On/Off apply to the model's actual IK, on both sides

- [ ] Replace `Sleeve IK` with a concise **`IK`** checkbox or equivalent clearly named On/Off control in the public UI (e.g. `#comparison-ik`). Its **On** state must mean that **all supported, valid IK controllers defined by the current PMX model** are evaluated, subject to authored VMD IK enable/disable keys, not only sleeve controllers. Its **Off** state must bypass **all** IK operations and restore the raw VMD pose on both sides.
- [ ] Derive IK controllers, effector/link identities, full XYZ link bounds, iteration caps, limits, source ordering/deformation layer and phase from actual **per-model source metadata**, not a hard-coded Uka name allowlist or a shortcut that copies rotations. Enumerate Gene Light's actual IK controllers and dependencies too; Gene must not show an inaccurately effective toggle if it has no executable IK. Report supported/unsupported counts and reasons (in concise diagnostics/hidden details).
- [ ] Investigate both runtimes' full IK capability. LEFT: `@takahirox/three-mmd` direct PMX IK/CCDIKSolver or `MMDAnimationHelper` with physics explicitly off. RIGHT: current glTF extension/retained source solver metadata and runtime. If a runtime needs general IK work for fixed axes, per-axis limits, ordered chains, VMD toggles or other valid PMX constructs, implement the necessary capability **symmetrically** or report an explicit blocker and separate follow-up work. Do **not** say generic `IK On` while silently executing only a subset, unless the unavailable subset is plainly disclosed and toggle behavior is clearly marked partial/disabled. Don't silently restrict IK to one-axis sleeve links.
- [ ] Preserve a single absolute animation clock and evaluate IK **after** raw VMD bone/morph motion in the correct project-defined PMX order, including VMD's per-controller on/off records where relevant; a global `IK Off` must override all controller switches. Keep append/grant and Bullet/rigid-body physics off for this task unless proven indispensable and explicitly explained; IK is not a disguised all-physics toggle.
- [ ] Implement a deterministic raw pose → optional IK evaluation pipeline: repeated seeks to the same timestamp (including backwards), enabling/disabling IK while paused, motion switches Rest/facial/Laugh/Apology, restart, loop and model changes must **not accumulate** IK transforms or change the authored raw pose after Off. Preserve original rest transforms, skinning identity and source bytes. Leave Toon/PBR switching neutral.
- [ ] No full-model or per-motion renderer reload just to toggle IK. Preserve the one-character / multi-animation glTF assets and no-new-network-request motion switching delivered by Issue #67.
- [ ] Keep sleeve-follow accuracy from the measured six chains and ensure other IK can be enabled without unexpectedly corrupting the sleeve pose, feet, or unanimated joints. Correct known mismatches at the algorithm/data level, not via per-model vertex hacks.

### 3. Truthful interface, documentation and tests

- [ ] Public UI **does not show** `View` or `Sleeve IK`; shows **`IK`** with meaningful enabled/disabled state and a sensible default (prefer On for supported models, otherwise explicitly disabled + reason). Keep compact controls and collapsed `About & credits`, source licenses and model option labels `Uka` / `Gene Light`; no verbose visible explanations.
- [ ] Status and diagnostics distinguish `IK off`, `IK on (all applicable source chains executed)`, and `IK unavailable/partially supported`. The `info.execution` diagnostic must reflect **actual executed chains**, not just `checked` or `isUka`; remove or repurpose obsolete `sleeveIK` semantics. No unsupported native MikuMikuDance fidelity claims.
- [ ] Add Node/source conformance and real-asset browser tests: Uka all **10** IK identities enumerated, matching source membership & bounds, Gene enumeration, non-sleeve IK effect on the appropriate controlled pose (or explicit justified no-effect for particular VMD keys), complete IK Off restoring raw poses, and Uka six sleeve chains still following arms under IK On. Compare PMX/Toon/PBR world-space IK targets/links and independently rendered pixels at representative frames for Laugh/Apology.
- [ ] Test frame 0/nonzero/end, backwards seek, repeated same-time seeking, toggling IK while paused/playing, switching among all three VMD clips and Rest, model changes, PBR/Toon, Outline and orbit interactions. Ensure no resource leaks, new model fetches on IK changes, hidden-view timing defects, stale VMD controller switches or disabled UI with false success.
- [ ] Update existing camera- and sleeve-specific tests, `docs/public-motion.md`, `docs/uka-sleeves.md`, README and relevant credits to explain the actual full IK runtime and its limitations, with source-level and observed evidence. Keep test-only camera poses reproducible without public View presets.
- [ ] Validate `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, applicable `npm run test:browser`, `npm run check:links` and `git diff --check`. Report actual passes/failures/skips and any remaining unsupported constraints. CI success by itself is not proof of original-MMD numerical fidelity.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No `View` selector in public character comparison; drag orbit/zoom and shared camera remain fully functional and motion switching doesn't reset camera.
- [ ] Visible toggle is simply **IK On/Off**, not `Sleeve IK`; **On processes the model's valid, executable IK chains as a whole**, including Uka's foot/toe and sleeve controllers where source/binding allows, and **Off processes none**.
- [ ] Both comparison panes follow the same global IK state, selected VMD IK keys and deterministic solver order; Uka sleeve tracking is preserved. Explicit blocking/diagnostics if full scope cannot be run correctly — no false generic-IK-success claim for partial execution.
- [ ] Gene IK behavior derives from its own PMX (not Uka-specific hard-coding); physics stays off.
- [ ] Existing multi-animation single-glTF, per-model resource reuse, playback controls, source-preservation and rights, synthetic tests and responsive layout remain intact.
- [ ] Real source/pose/pixel regressions plus build/typecheck/Node/browser/link checks pass.

## Related work

- [Issue #67 / merged PR #68](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues/67): multiple animations per glTF, source-verified Uka sleeve-only fix.
- [Uka sleeve source measurements](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-sleeves.md).
- [Uka model source IK inventory](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-inventory.json).
- [Full source transport / solver capability limits](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/source-transport.md).
- [Direct PMX reference IK implementation](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/CCDIKSolver.ts).

## Required post-merge verification

None required unless the implementer introduces merge-only deployment behavior. Preserve any optional Windows original-MMD parity comparison as **separate evidence**, not an assumed result.
